verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak stack. A floating notched beige block and a tiny pool thumbnail sit awkwardly at the top, disconnected from everything, and the pool image is shrunk to a trivial size. The headline is not centred and sits on a different left edge from the top elements, and the bottom third is dead space. A at least moves the beige accent block to the bottom-right, echoing the original and partly filling that dead space, though the block is jammed against the edge. B leaves the bottom completely empty, and a stray beige sliver peeks out under the pool thumbnail like a leftover.
